stemMd: What limitation did the researcher discover in the surviving plan?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It had been drawn after the theatre was demolished

options.label: B
options.textMd: It represented a proposal rather than a verified completed arrangement

options.label: D
options.textMd: It was a complete photographic survey

options.label: E
options.textMd: It proved that construction made no changes

explanationMd: The key discovery concerns the status of the document. A proposed arrangement cannot automatically be treated as an as-built record, especially when a note and photographs indicate later changes.

distractorRationale.a: The passage does not give that chronology.
distractorRationale.c: It was used to study seating.
distractorRationale.d: It was a plan, with later photographs as separate evidence.
